subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw land this PR's default-disabled `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` plus shared `onTaskTimeout` queue hook as the supported compatibility/session-state boundary for wedged deferred turn maintenance?
rationale: The code path is plausible and well covered, but the new config and shared queue API become supported behavior and affect how opted-in deployments trade background maintenance completion for same-session responsiveness.

options.title: Accept opt-in timeout contract
options.body: Merge after confirming the default-disabled config key and queue hook are the intended supported boundary for this bug class.

options.title: Narrow queue API first
options.body: Ask for a maintenance-local mechanism if maintainers do not want `onTaskTimeout` exposed on the shared queue contract.

options.title: Choose different policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the preferred product behavior is a broader coalescing or recovery-policy design instead of an operator-tuned timeout.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in timeout contract
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the default-disabled config key and queue hook are the intended supported boundary for this bug class.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the core context-engine transcript maintenance surface and merged the background turn-maintenance feature this PR changes.
